description: A small orange ball sits on a green bedspread in front of a blank wall and a white panel propped at the far right. The left hand comes in from the left and the right hand from the right; the ball is briefly a two-hand object as both hands corral it, then it becomes a right-hand object as the right hand rolls it to the right, after which the left hand nudges it back left and the right hand continues rolling it along the bed.
